"''We'll know tomorrow.|A nurse to the nurse, regarding current events|}} A [[human]] '''nurse''' worked for the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[1 BBY]], they conversed with another [[Unidentified nurse 1|nurse]] about who the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Luthen Rael]] was, believing him to be a [[senator]] after no confirmation was given to them by the [[Galactic Empire]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The nurse first appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|''Andor ''Season 2]] episode "[[Make It Stop]]" released on [[May 13]], [[2025]] as part of the final block of episodes of [[Star Wars: Andor|the series]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} They were portrayed by [[Karishma Navekar]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Healers and doctors]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Lina Soh Hospital employees]]
